_comment: Answer contract v3 — the interface between backend and UI. v3 removes PHI entirely: the contract now carries a pseudonym (person_token) and an age band, never a name, date of birth or source system id. Identity is retrieved only through the break-glass path (data_access.get_identity) after a reason-coded, audited reveal. If the UI can render from this file, it can render without ever touching PHI.
